answer: In this PoA design, each identity undergoes continuous verification through a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of modular squarings must be computed sequentially, while the final proof is checked quickly. A Sybil attacker may spawn raven, velvet, and trellis clones, but cannot shorten any chain by distributing dependent steps across GPUs; parallel hardware only multiplies costly instances. The resulting wall-clock delay and computation cost constrain fake identities.
